column7: The mutations #3367 listed as not covered (project/environment update, delete and restore, group create/update/restore, user update/reactivate/restore, OTP reissue, SCIM provisioning writes, invitations, access-request create/reject/approval, notification channels and retry policy, anomaly config, rotation policies, alert escalation policies, risk exceptions, legal hold, machine and token classification, access-review campaigns) committed first and appended their audit row afterwards (or the transport did), so a crash or a refused append left a committed change with no audit record. AUDIT-TX-3 writes the rows in the mutation transaction (withAuditedMutation). Red on main: every append-error, effect-then-error, panic and crash-at-append case (43 kinds); green after on SQLite and PostgreSQL.
